amount: integer base units 1..4611686018427387903 (0 only where a zero amount is explicitly allowed)
encoding: canonical JSON (sorted keys, ASCII, integers only, depth <= 16, strings <= 4096); strict parsing rejects duplicate keys, floats and constants
signature: Ed25519 over tag || sha256(canonical(body)); the tag separates message types; the body binds protocol, environment and authority

intent_transitions.precondition: actor may act within its grant; available >= amount ceiling; recipient permitted; asset/domain/environment match
intent_transitions.idempotency: request_id: a repeated proposal returns the same intent

intent_transitions.precondition: signer holds the account key; canonical message bound to protocol, environment, actor, authority, asset, ceiling, recipient, obligation, grant, nonce, policy
intent_transitions.idempotency: same nonce -> same signature; a changed field is a new intent

intent_transitions.precondition: the domain authority (single fenced writer) orders the transition; obligation (if any) outstanding >= amount
intent_transitions.idempotency: commit sequence assigned once; retries return the recorded commit

intent_transitions.precondition: same transaction as commit in the local domain (domain-local settlement)
intent_transitions.effect: committed_outgoing -> recipient available; fee legs to the treasury account; receipt issued
reserved -> available (release of provably unexposed amount)

intent_transitions.precondition: not yet committed; signature retained as evidence
any precondition failed before value changed
intent_transitions.idempotency: the refusal is recorded with its reason

intent_transitions.precondition: the response to the submitter was lost after commit
intent_transitions.effect: none: the commit stands; the submitter must reconcile by intent id

intent_transitions.precondition: a bounded dispute referencing this settlement is opened
intent_transitions.effect: the disputed amount is marked on the recipient (available -> disputed) only to the extent still available; history untouched

allocation_transitions.precondition: source account available >= amount; destination domain pinned
authority orders the export; epoch current
allocation_transitions.effect: in_transit -> backing:exported (nonspendable at the source, irrevocable once a certificate is issued)

allocation_transitions.precondition: certificate signed by the source authority (bound to destination, asset, amount, allocation id, epoch, policy, commit evidence) and placed in the outbox
allocation_transitions.effect: certificate durable; source backing stays locked

allocation_transitions.precondition: certificate verifies under the pinned source root; destination == this domain; allocation id unseen (tombstone check); epoch policy
allocation_transitions.effect: claim credited: backing:claim -> recipient available at the destination (spendable there)

allocation_transitions.precondition: signed import acknowledgment delivered to the source
allocation_transitions.effect: source marks the allocation acknowledged; nothing moves

allocation_transitions.precondition: the full allocation is unspent at the destination (partial return unsupported)
allocation_transitions.effect: destination claim made nonspendable (available -> in_transit) and a signed return request issued

allocation_transitions.precondition: return request verifies under the pinned destination root and names an allocation this source exported
allocation_transitions.effect: backing:exported -> source account available; destination burns its claim on the return certificate

allocation_transitions.precondition: conflicting signed histories, cloned authority or an unresolved rollback watermark
allocation_transitions.effect: the allocation and the domain's outward spending are frozen until an administrator reconciles

finality.local_authorization: the actor may attempt the action within its grant (nothing recorded yet)
finality.durable_local_commit: the domain authority ordered and durably recorded the economic transition (commit sequence)
finality.delivery_acknowledgment: another endpoint received a message or artifact (says nothing about acceptance or settlement)
finality.work_acceptance: the frozen contract policy produced an acceptance decision on the delivered evidence root
finality.cross_domain_pending_claim: an exported allocation whose import or backing is still being reconciled
finality.domain_local_settlement: the obligation was paid under this domain's declared rules (spendable here)
finality.reconciled_inter_domain_settlement: both domains' durable state and the backing satisfy the transfer policy (acknowledged allocation; no duplicated ownership)

trust_model.supported_domain: a trusted ordering authority with one fenced writer (SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE on durable storage), authenticated actors, explicit administrator powers
not_provided: independent validators (replicated processes of one operator are not independent)
equivocation prevention by signature alone (a key holder can sign two histories)
detected: conflicting signed histories for one allocation id
rollback below the export watermark after a backup restore
trust_model.boundary: crash / retry tolerance is provided by durable commits and idempotent request ids; Byzantine authority behaviour is detected and quarantined where two signed histories meet, never prevented

ordering: one commit sequence per domain, assigned by the fenced writer in transaction order; messages carry a causality reference and are applied idempotently by id with durable tombstones
replay: intent nonces are unique per account; allocation ids and envelope ids are tombstoned for as long as they can affect economic state (never garbage-collected below the export watermark)
failure_and_recovery: every transition is one durable transaction with its outbox record; a lost response is reconciled by id (uncertain != not committed); a restored backup below the export watermark enters quarantine until reconciled; timeouts never recreate value
